about: Keyword vocabulary for the Thun Missiven, made for this collection from a reading of its regest drafts (15./17.11.2026), not taken from another edition. Six groups; each keyword has a short definition, which is what the model is shown. A letter gets one to four keywords. Proposals the model makes for missing keywords are collected in keywords/proposals.tsv, to extend the vocabulary by hand.
